subject: Secure-Dev Evidence: CI rollback proof & ephemeral-secret workflow
messages:
From: compliance@archon-audits.com
To: alex_martinez@redwoodinference.com
Cc: devops@finservco.com
Date: Tue, 05 Jun 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request: CI rollback trace and secret lifecycle

Hi Alex —

We're assembling the SIG + SOC2 evidence bundle for FinServCo (scope: inference-serving pipeline). Can you provide the following by EOD Friday (6/9):

- Chronological CI job history for recent rollback on 2028-05-30 (job IDs, timestamps, exit codes).
- The rollback runbook used and the annotated change request that triggered the rollback.
- Proof that no plaintext secrets were exposed during the rollback (rotation logs, KMS events).
- PR/merge audit that shows reviewer approvals and gate enforcement for the change.

If possible please include a scrubbed kv-rotation log and CI job export (CSV) plus any Jira or Drive links. We may request a short walkthrough after we validate.

Thanks,
Maya Singh
Senior Assessor
Archon Audits
attachments: none (initial request)

From: alex_martinez@redwoodinference.com
To: compliance@archon-audits.com
Cc: irene_choi@redwoodinference.com, grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com, devops@finservco.com
Date: Tue, 05 Jun 2028 09:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: CI rollback trace and secret lifecycle

Maya —

Thanks for the request. Attached are the artifacts that map to each ask:

- rollback_playbook.pdf (annotated runbook used by on-call to perform rollback on 2028-05-30).
- ci_job_history_export.csv (export of CI job IDs: 3421, 3422, 3423 — includes timestamps, git SHAs, exit codes).
- pr-merge-history.csv (PRs #1172/#1173 showing reviewer approvals and merge gate events).
- kv_rotation_redacted.log (rotation events with secret IDs hashed; values removed as requested).

Notes on controls:
- Rollback was executed from the protected release pipeline (pipeline: release-lane). All rollback actions required a two-person approval in the merge gate (code-review + ops approve).
- Secrets are stored in our ephemeral vault (redwood-ephemeral) with 15-minute TTL for deploy tokens; rotations are automated via KMS triggers. The attached kv_rotation_redacted.log shows rotation events and the KMS key IDs involved.
- CI jobs are configured to redact any environment variables in logs; full logs are retained in internal archive for 90 days and accessible on a need-to-know basis. We can provide additional audit logs if you need the KMS event correlation.

Drive link: https://drive.redwood-inference.com/secure/INF-2345-evidence
Jira: INF-2345 (rollback investigation and RCA)

If you want a 20–30 minute walkthrough of the pipeline and the KMS rotation trace, I can meet tomorrow afternoon.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Director, Developer Experience
Redwood Inference
attachments: rollback_playbook.pdf (pdf), ci_job_history_export.csv (csv), pr-merge-history.csv (csv), kv_rotation_redacted.log (txt)

Alex —

Thanks for pulling these together. A couple of requests before we send to the assessor bundle:

1) Please ensure the kv_rotation_redacted.log contains only hashed identifiers and no token material (we should keep the rotation metadata + key IDs but not any plaintext).
2) Add the CI job links or job-run IDs in the CSV (we need clickable links for the assessor to navigate the archived artifacts).
3) Can you include a short note (1–2 lines) in the runbook where the rollback decision point is recorded and who approved it (usernames).

I also recommend redacting IP addresses in the runbook screenshots — FinServCo prefers minimal infra details in artifact exports.

Once updated, I'll attach the final bundle to the SIG portal.

— Irene
Irene Choi
Security PM, Redwood Inference
